How to read this list

Accepted is EDGAR's acceptance time (ET). Filings accepted after 5:30 pm usually carry the next day's filing date; Forms 3, 4 and 5 keep the same date until 10:00 pm. Each filing appears once, on the day it was accepted.

Filing agent is the EDGAR account that submitted the filing (from the accession number). "Self-filed" means the company's own account. Software is the authoring tool stamped in the primary document; XML forms (3/4/5, 13F, Form D) carry none.

Agent differs flags 10-K, 10-Q, 20-F, 40-F, 8-K, 6-K, 11-K, proxy and NT filings submitted by an agent other than the company's usual periodic agent in ENGAGE. Deal documents (424B, FWP, 425) are not compared, because they normally go through deal counsel.

Opportunity Index, rank, campaigns and next deadline come from ENGAGE. Click any row for the full record. Source: SEC EDGAR daily index, current-filings feed and company submissions.
